notes.title: July 27, 2025 update
notes.content: Achievements were added in the July 27, 2025 update.

notes.title: Continuation of the legendary MEMOLOGY
notes.content: [p][b]ARE YOU ALSO TIRED OF THAT SAME ADVERTISING AT THE MOST INAPPROPRIATE MOMENT? + ARE YOU WAITING FOR ACHIEVMENTHUNTING?[/b][/p][p]Surely, your expectations from it did not correspond to reality... One day, our GFF team came across unrealistic gameplay on a video hosting site, as a result of which we decided to bring to life the version of it that we ourselves thought up in our heads as a continuation of what we saw.[/p][p]We present to your attention a new part of the series - [b]MEMOLOGY: ESCAPE OF MEMES[/b].[/p][p][u]What will await you in the game?[/u][/p][p]1) Favorite characters from famous memes;[/p][p]2) Dynamic action in which you have to avoid obstacles;[/p][p]3) Atmosphere, graphics and cheerful music that will definitely make you smile.[/p][p]Also, soon there will be a large-scale update of the game, in which we will add achievements with memes![/p][p][b]Join our meme society, we will be glad to receive any feedback from you for our version of continuing advertising at maximum settings.[/b][/p]
